C.H. Robinson to Acquire Rival RXO

Freight brokerage company C.H. Robinson has announced its intention to acquire its smaller rival, RXO. C.H. Robinson CEO Dave Bozeman stated that the deal is expected to provide significant benefits for shareholders, customers, and employees.
